correction: A chmod of a directory that updex created must go through descriptors, not paths: O_NOFOLLOW protects only the last component, so reopening each created directory by its full path follows an ancestor that another process replaced with a symlink, and chmods an unrelated existing directory. mkdirAllMode creates each missing directory with mkdirat in its parent's descriptor, opens it with openat O_NOFOLLOW and fchmods that descriptor; a directory that another process created first (EEXIST) keeps its mode.
